chemistry-killer-11.goal: Analyze the principles of Xawaaraha falgalka, mabda'a Le Chatelier iyo unugga kimikada (Inquiry) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
chemistry-killer-11.material:
Joogtada dheellitirka xoogga ee falgalka $\mathrm{N_2O_4(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NO_2(g)}$ waa $K = 0.4$ (halbeeg lama qorin) heerkul go'an. Heerkulkan, saddex weel ayaa mid walba lagu daray $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ iyo $\mathrm{NO_2}$ oo waqti dheer la daayay.
(I) Mug 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.4 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
(II) Mug 0.5 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.1 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.2 mol
(III) Mug 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.2 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
Isbarbar dhigga tilmaamaha falgalka $Q$ iyo $K$, kuwee ayaa si sax ah u xiraya jihada falgalka ee dhacaya ilaa dheellitirka la gaadho weel kasta?

(II) Mug 0.5 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.1 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.2 mol
(III) Mug 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.2 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
Isbarbar dhigga tilmaamaha falgalka $Q$ iyo $K$, kuwee ayaa si sax ah u xiraya jihada falgalka ee dhacaya ilaa dheellitirka la gaadho weel kasta?
chemistry-killer-11.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Xisaabinta xoogga. (I) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.4/2.0 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M. (II) 0.5 L: [N2O4] = 0.1/0.5 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2/0.5 = 0.4 M. (III) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.1 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M.
Tallaabo 2: Xisaabinta Q. (I) Q = 0.2²/0.2 = 0.2 < 0.4 → falgalka hore. (II) Q = 0.4²/0.2 = 0.8 > 0.4 → falgalka dambe. (III) Q = 0.2²/0.1 = 0.4 = K → xaalad dheellitir ah.
Jawaab: (I) falgalka hore, (II) falgalka dambe, (III) xaalad dheellitir ah (c). (Jawaabaha khaldan: Haddii Q lagu xisaabiyo mole, (I) 0.4²/0.4 = 0.4, (II) 0.2²/0.1 = 0.4 labaduba si qalad ah waxay u muuqdaan dheellitir.)
